summary: RptMnuInvoicing is a user control that supports generating invoices and related reports for placements. The control provides a filter-rich UI, involving dropdowns and choosers for agencies, departments, programs, terms, governing organizations, sites, placement request types, cohorts, and courses. It allows users to specify invoice statuses and options for inclusion. The control supports saving/restoring user filters, validating input, and exporting report data (notably to CSV via a stored procedure). It differentiates between 'receiving' and 'placing' modes, affecting available options and field behavior.
purpose: To allow users (administrators/staff) to filter, generate, and export invoicing reports for placement requests, with detailed criteria for agencies, organizations, sites, cohorts/courses, placement types, terms/dates, invoice statuses, and to save preferences for future sessions.
actors: System (for filter persistence and report execution)

workflows.name: Prepare and Run Invoice Report
steps: User selects filtering criteria via dropdowns and choosers for agencies, departments, programs, terms, sites, governing orgs, placement request types, cohorts/courses.
System loads and binds values to dropdowns, respecting mode (receiving/placing) and saved filters.
If 'term' mode, user must select at least one cohort/course; if 'date' mode, user must specify valid start/end dates.
User can specify invoice statuses to include.
User can choose inclusion options: confirmed, accepted, or all except declined/cancelled.
User can include/exclude QESPA, show details for each student, select placement request types, sites, etc.
System validates input, showing errors if required fields are missing.
User clicks to run report; system constructs parameters, calls stored procedure ('ReportInvoicingCSV'), retrieves and outputs report data.
Report output can be displayed and/or downloaded (CSV), with header/context description generated programmatically.
System saves filter selections for persistence.

business_rules: In 'receiving' mode, dropdowns restrict available choices (e.g., only user's agency visible).
In 'placing' mode, dropdowns differ to show broader options.
At least one cohort/course is required in 'term' mode.
Start and end dates are required in 'date' mode.
Cannot select more than system maximum for cohort/courses.
Saved filters are used to restore previous selection.
Invoice statuses are selectable via checkboxes, used as filters.
Placement request types can be all or partial, controlled via checkbox and selection list.
Available dropdown options may be subject to system permissions/settings.
validations: startDate required if not in term mode.
endDate required if not in term mode.
cohort/course required if in term mode.
Selection list size limited by MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
calculations: Splitting CohortCourseIDList into CohortIDList and CourseIDList for report parameterization.
Header/context description composed dynamically from current selections.
conditions: ReceivingMode: changes dropdown contents and UI behavior.
termMode: affects required fields and available options.
Show details for each student: toggles output granularity.
IncludeOption: affects which placement requests are included.
Invoice status checkboxes: toggle corresponding filters.
IncludeStartBefore/includeEndAfter: affect inclusion of requests based on date range.
system_behavior: Dropdowns and choosers are dynamically loaded and data bound.
Saved filter values are restored, including visual selection of lists.
JavaScript used for UI manipulation (moving items, toggling controls).
Report is generated server-side via stored procedure, parameters from UI selections.
Report output header describes included criteria.
Errors are shown if validation fails.
dependencies: UserSession for permissions, saved filters, locale formatting.
Codes, Agencies, Departments, Programs, Terms, Sites, GoverningOrgs, TimetableEntries for dropdown data.
SQL Server stored procedures: ReportInvoicingCSV, ReportInvoicingCSVContext.
exceptions: If required fields are missing (start/end date, cohort/course), report generation is aborted and error message displayed.
If selection list exceeds maximum allowed, error message is shown.
If PRTypeIDList is empty and not 'All', error is shown.
